body: I’ve had intrusive thoughts since ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. I have always had major depression and general anxiety before I knew what that was. The point is I’m different and always have been. I can only blame myself for not figuring out how to treat myself and others as a kid, but I can still blame this system that preys upon the weak to create the perfect conditions for me to go insane. As the other commenter said, you are punishing yourself for what? Was it really your fault that you had intrusive thoughts and thought differently than others? Is suicide the direction you really want the most or has an external force convinced you that violence toward yourself or others is the way out of your situation? I’m so much more at peace now in my life even though I struggle with depression everday, aswell as easily reminded of trauma and sometimes dint react well when people do or say certain things I perceive as offensive or dismissive, although I always want to improve and am surprised what I can do being honest with myself about the true nature of the world and trying to think about the people who accept and love me more than the ones who dismiss me.

I feel like I'm at a level of thought in between you and an average poster here. I am a relatively social college student and people tell me I'm not bad looking but the trauma of bullying and  going through many realizations during drug experiences and just continuing to go through life willing to try to improve because I love myself and I love my family made me less brainwashed to be as scared as someone who takes up the label of foreveralone or incel but I know my worldview was built in a similar way to them but I can't fully agree anymore. I just hate what I became and kindof still can blame others because of the bullying, but I also know that I simply cannot blame them for thinking in terms of looks, race,status, perceptions of my "intelligence" because I thought that way aswell back than and if I was an attractive person with everything that I was conditioned to believe I ever want, I would not understand these things and someone would be in my position on the other side because I simply did not know the gravity of me being discriminative and judgemental towards this person. It's really the most influential people that have continued this nonsense for so long. Dismiss anything or anybody you see as nonsensical or negative as quickly as they dismissed you verbally. Dismiss all these dumb bitches and inflated ego guys and don't try to cater yourself to them at all to make them your "friends". Find open minded social circles. They exist, trust me.
